column1: To make our economy stronger and more productive, we must make health care more affordable, ensuring the affordability of essential services while empowering families and small businesses alike with practical solutions. By expanding community health centers, modernizing technological infrastructures, and enhancing accountability through bipartisan collaboration, we can reduce medical errors and curb wasted expenditures. Our dedicated public servants, working hand in hand with local communities, shall secure accessible, quality health care for every American citizen.
